title: Multilevel Neural Corrections with Adaptive Sampling for Partial Differential Equations
summary: We propose a multi-level framework for deep neural PDE solvers that integrates adaptive sampling with additive neural corrections. At each level, an adaptive sampling distribution is constructed from normalized residual-gradient indicators inherited from the preceding levels, thereby concentrating collocation points in regions where the current approximation exhibits large local errors or reduced regularity.
